Name: my kity
Author: angrybeaversworstfan
Description:
UPDATE 5/5/2021: i'm very sorry to come with a more serious/downer update to this mod, but as of the 3rd of this month, sergeant party (my kitty as stated above) has passed away after a long battle with FIV. i want to say thank you, from the bottom of my heart, to everyone who's viewed/downloaded/commented on this mod, i'm so glad you enjoy it as much as i do and that i have a way to memorialize him in one of my favorite games. he was the best kitty/guardian angel i could ever ask for, and i believe he's in a better place now while still being forever in my heart.

i'm not sure if i will work on this mod anymore/end up adding the portrait, but if i do i will certainly post another update. thank you again to everyone, and i hope you stay safe and have a good rest of your day :')

Downloads.Description: contains manifest.json, content.json, readme.txt and sarge assets!
